The '''Gungan Swamp Town''' was a [[Rorgungans|Rorgungan]] town and military camp on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Rorgungans_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rorgungans patrolling near the Gungan Swamp Town.]]
After [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] brokered peace with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a number of more extremist [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] violently opposed to any alliance between [[Naboo (people)/Legends|humans]] and Gungans and fled to Rori, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Naboo.<ref name="CDAG" /> These Rorgungans established the swamp town deep within the [[Lake Octir Swamp|swamps]] of Rori, as a place to live in isolation from the outside world. The Gungans who lived there were very hostile to outsiders.<ref name="SWG:RGST" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rorgungan commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hassk (Gungan)|Hassk]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Ori (Gungan)|Ori]] and [[Heb Nee]] were notable residents of the swamp town.<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> From there, Captain Hassk intended to recruit Gungans from Naboo to support the Rorian Gungans in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="10HSTG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] fought several Rorgungans in the swamp town and stole an [[Urnsor'is SoulLeecher]] sword.<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Swamp Town was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Gungan Swamp Town Swamptown was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
